name: gizza-ai/image-perspective-warp
summary: Apply a four-corner perspective transform to an image.

tool.description: Apply a free four-corner perspective transform to an image (keystone / skew correction, or deliberate perspective distortion). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call). Corners are pixel coordinates or W/H frame constants.

bl_x.description: X of the bottom-left corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default 0.

bl_y.description: Y of the bottom-left corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default H.

br_x.description: X of the bottom-right corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default W.

br_y.description: Y of the bottom-right corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default H.

interpolation.description: Pixel interpolation: linear (faster) or cubic (smoother edges). Default: linear.

mode.description: correct = the four corners mark a rectangle in the photo and are stretched to fill the frame (keystone/skew correction); distort = the image corners are pushed to the four points (add a tilt). Default: correct.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

tl_x.description: X of the top-left corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default 0.

tl_y.description: Y of the top-left corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default 0.

tr_x.description: X of the top-right corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default W.

tr_y.description: Y of the top-right corner coordinate for ffmpeg perspective. Use a pixel number, or W/H for the image width/height edge. Default 0.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
